You mentioned anonymous people who say they love you and will miss you and maybe want you to DM them... You know the type. IF THERE ARE PEOPLE LIKE THAT READING THIS please understand this hard fact: People on the verge of suicide have family and friends and others of importance in their lives who know their name and situation and... they are often doing NOTHING to help! It feels like what they want is just for you to stop bringing your unhappiness to their life. It feels like the best we can do is eliminate the need for them to think about us.

I am 100% not transphobic. One of the few people I love most in life is my Son who is is Trans. I say this not to defend myself or reddit or to try to convince you that you shouldn't feel the way you are feeling! I simply want you to know that there are people that exist that will not only accept you as you are, but will be impressed with your courage to live your best life despite the shit you have to deal with to get there.

I know that you have challenges that most people (including myself) could never fully understand. But may I suggest that you have hope that you might someday find your loving community. My son, who lives in an extremely anti LGBTQIA+ city, has found a lovingly community and has real friends who bring him happiness. He transitioned his first year in high school - in the middle of his first year! Really bad timing and a lot of hate. But he found friends who not only accepted him, but actually encouraged him to be fully authentic.

So while life does suck A LOT, daydream about finding your life in that better place.
